Anniversary.Title: Renew at your anniversary date (recommended)
Anniversary.Summary: Your renewal takes effect on your anniversary date. Nothing is billed until then, and your anniversary date stays the same.
Anniversary.Detail: Everything you renew is priced together for the best available volume discount, including any quantity changes or new products you add. Pricing reflects the rates in effect on your anniversary date, which may be higher if prices change before then.

Locked.Prompt_one: Your renewal date is {{date}} ({{count}} day away). Your renewal is set up.
Locked.Prompt_other: Your renewal date is {{date}} ({{count}} days away). Your renewal is set up.
Locked.Title: Renew at your anniversary date (confirmed)
Locked.Summary: You can carry on and place another order against this renewal.
Locked.Detail: Anything you add or change joins the same renewal, so it stays priced together, and nothing is billed until your anniversary date.
Locked.Note: You can keep making changes right up until it takes effect.

Now.Title: Renew now
Now.Summary: Renewing now locks in today's pricing. If prices rise before your anniversary date, you avoid the increase.
Now.Detail: Your renewal takes effect today and is invoiced immediately, and your anniversary date moves forward. Adding products or increasing quantities is handled separately afterwards, and may not receive the same combined discount.

Locked.Prompt: Your renewal date is now {{date}}. Your renewal is already in place.
Locked.Title: Renew now (confirmed)
Locked.Summary: You can carry on and place another order on your renewed subscriptions.
Locked.Detail: Your early renewal has already taken effect, so anything you add now is invoiced when you place it, and the renewal timing itself cannot be changed back.
